method: Load the retained LLVM export, require type llvm.coverage.json.export/version 3.1.0, and index files by their original filename. Parse every LCOV SF/DA/LF/LH record before canonicalizing paths.

For each LLVM line, carry the last preceding segment; starts are non-gap segments with hasCount and isRegionEntry. A skipped leading region suppresses inherited coverage; any counted entry maps the line. Its count is max(prior count, non-gap entry counts). Compare this independent line map exactly with LCOV DA entries; LF/LH must equal LLVM summary counts.

Union canonical file/line instances by maximum hit count. Verify all retained source-inventory file hashes and line counts; recompute the inventory statically with retained Cargo metadata, without invoking Cargo or coverage. Exclude only test-only modules and each inventoried cfg(test) omission. The three declaration-only unmapped files have no runtime executable lines.

For each production file, denominator is mapped lines outside omissions; numerator counts positive DA hits. Compare mapped/uncovered line arrays and counts with the summary, then sum per crate and check covered*100 >= total*80. All 455 raw LLVM/LCOV records and all 121 production-file summaries reconcile.

Hash all 3103 nonempty profile files, compare the exact profile-directory set, manifest and merge-list membership, and match explicit CLI/daemon child PIDs. Hash metadata/exports/collection/summary/reuse bytes; the architecture receipt names that same reuse file and its log says no collection. The collection receipt contains exactly one native workspace llvm-cov invocation for the final inputs.
